svg.title: Two link directions can exceed one monitor port
svg.desc: At simultaneous line rate, two one-gigabit Ethernet directions can offer two gigabits per second to a one-gigabit aggregate output. Separate feeds can avoid that particular shared output limit.

g.text: Two link directions can exceed one monitor port
Each capture path has its own capacity.
Correlate both captures using aligned timestamps.
1 Gbps + 1 Gbps can exceed a 1 Gbps output.
Check the TAP, output and sensor drop counters.
A healthy production link can coexist with incomplete capture evidence.
